summary: Russian forces launched sustained multi-day attacks on Odesa region with cruise missiles, loitering drones, and ballistic weapons, generating at least 10 air raid alerts daily. Ukrainian drones struck multiple logistics targets in Moscow region including Podolsk fuel depot and Wildberries hub on July 20, 2026. Russian aircraft posed missile threats toward Crimea and Odesa with Su-34 and Oniks/X-31P/Iskander-M launches.
key_points: Russian forces attacked Odesa region for several consecutive days with cruise missiles, reactive drones, and ballistic weapons, with at least 10 air alerts daily (Source: @UkraineNow/82775).
Ukrainian drones attacked Podolsk fuel depot in Moscow region on July 20, 2026 as a main target of mass drone strike on the region (Source: @eRadarrua/101779).
Ukrainian drones also struck Wildberries logistics hub in Koledino and Southern Gates industrial park (65,000 sq m) in Moscow region on July 20, 2026 (Source: @eRadarrua/101780).
Russian Su-34 fighter-bomber headed toward Crimea with threat of Kh-59 missile launch (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69255).
Russian drone strike on Nova Poshta terminal near Kharkiv killed four people (Source: @eRadarrua/101721).
Russian forces struck Sumy with seven KAB bombs, three hospitalized, one possibly under rubble (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile threat declared from occupied Crimea and from Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69243).
Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed one and wounded three, five-story building damaged, two trapped (Source: @UkraineNow/82774).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched sustained multi-day attacks on Odesa region with cruise missiles, loitering drones, and ballistic weapons, generating at least 10 air raid alerts daily and 50-60 air targets per day. Ukrainian drones struck multiple logistics targets in Moscow region including Podolsk fuel depot and Wildberries hub on July 20, 2026, blocking operations. Russian aircraft posed missile threats toward Crimea and Odesa with Su-34 and Oniks/X-31P/Iskander-M launches across the front.

points: Odesa region faced consecutive days of Russian attacks with cruise missiles, reactive drones, and ballistic weapons; authorities reported at least 10 air alerts daily and 50-60 air targets per day, with 18 dead and 69 wounded including six children in the last week (Source: @UkraineNow/82775).
A Nova Poshta terminal near Kharkiv was attacked by Russian drones, killing four people according to eRadarrua reporting on the strike (Source: @eRadarrua/101721).
Sumy was struck by Russian forces with seven KAB bombs; three were hospitalized and one person may remain under rubble with rescue ongoing per OVA head Hryhorov (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).

Zaporizhzhia was hit by Russian forces killing one and wounding three; a five-story building was significantly damaged and two people (woman and child) trapped under a multi-story building (Source: @UkraineNow/82774).
A Russian drone attack on a passenger train in Zaporizhzhia region caused no deaths; one conductor lightly wounded after Uz monitoring group ordered evacuation (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Suburban Kharkiv was struck by enemy with three dead and 13 wounded preliminarily per OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/82766).
Ukrainian drones attacked Podolsk fuel depot in Moscow region on July 20, 2026 as one of the main targets of a mass drone attack on the Moscow region that night (Source: @eRadarrua/101779).

Ukrainian drones struck the Wildberries logistics hub in Koledino settlement, Podolsk district, with hundreds of night and morning shift workers fleeing and operations fully blocked (Source: @eRadarrua/101780).

Ukrainian drones burned one of the largest Russian logistics objects (65,000 sq m), the Southern Gates industrial park on MKAD in Domodedovo, Moscow region, on July 20, 2026 (Source: @eRadarrua/101778).

Two Majors weekly summary stated enemy reported attack on a substation in Yalta, Crimea, and Wildberries warehouses were attacked with devastating strikes on civilian targets in Moscow region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31741).
Russia's FSB unit 'Gorynych' of Donetsk Directorate destroyed Ukrainian fighters in Konstantinovka per TASS video (Source: @tass_agency/386035).
Russian Ministry of Defense reported VSU lost transport and drone control points on Kramatorsk direction (Source: @tass_agency/386023).
Russian units have about 8 km remaining to reach Slaviansk per a company commander cited by TASS (Source: @tass_agency/386021).
VSU concentrated about three brigades of personnel in Slaviansk per a TASS commander interview (Source: @tass_agency/386003).
Reactive drones reported at Sloviansk and Sosnytsia in Chernihiv region per eRadarrua tracking (Source: @eRadarrua/101751).
Russian FSB 'Gorynych' unit destroyed Ukrainian terrorists in Konstantinovka per TASS video from DNR FSB (Source: @tass_agency/386035).
VSU lost transport and UAV control points on Kramatorsk direction per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/386023).
Reactive drones detected near Stepne heading toward Zaporizhzhia city per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101742).
Chernihiv region saw reactive drones at Snovsk and Sosnytsia, and a drone near Ripky with two reactive heading south Zaporizhzhia toward Mykolaiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/101748).
Sumy was struck by seven KAB bombs with three hospitalized and one possibly under rubble per OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Drones on Sumshchyna passed Khotin toward Stepanivka/Sum and passed Hlukhiv southwest course per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69287).
Kharkiv region drones directed past Lymanivka toward Sakhnovshchyna and Nova Vodolaha, and past Zolochiv southeast (Source: @kpszsu/69297).
Kharkiv suburb strike killed three and wounded 13 preliminarily per OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/82766).
Three drones reported at Vilshany and two at Zlatopil in Kharkiv region per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101776).
Odesa region under sustained Russian attack with cruise missiles, reactive drones, ballistic weapons; 10 alerts daily, 50-60 targets daily, 18 dead 69 wounded last week (Source: @UkraineNow/82775).
Black Sea activity: 3 drones opposite Tuzly, 1 opposite Vylkove, toward Odesa bay, 2 near spit, Orion operating per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101750).
Missile toward Chornomorsk and Odesa bay reported by eRadarrua and kpszsu with drones from Black Sea (Source: @kpszsu/69295).
Oniks missile on Odesa, Kh-31P on Odesa/Chornomorsk, cruise missile on Odesa Poscot per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69245).
Zaporizhzhia strike killed one wounded three, five-story damaged, two trapped per OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/82774).
Reactive drone on Zaporizhzhia past Stepne per eRadarrua tracking (Source: @eRadarrua/101742).
Russian Su-34 fighter-bomber headed toward Crimea with Kh-59 missile launch threat per mon1tor_ua alert (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69255).
Iskander-M ballistic threat from occupied Crimea and from Taganrog Rostov region declared by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69243).
Oniks missile toward Odesa, X-31P toward Odesa/Chornomorsk, cruise missiles toward Odesa/Lymanka per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69261).
Ukrainian drones struck Moscow region targets: Podolsk fuel depot, Wildberries Koledino hub, Southern Gates Domodedovo on July 20 2026 (Source: @eRadarrua/101778).
Enemy tactical aviation active on southern direction per kpszsu warning (Source: @kpszsu/69291).
42 ballistic and about ten hypersonic missiles plus kamikaze drones hit Kiev and environs, largest blow since SMO start per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).

key_developments: Odesa region subjected to consecutive days of Russian cruise missiles, reactive drones, and ballistic attacks with 10 daily alerts and 50-60 targets daily, 18 dead 69 wounded last week (Source: @UkraineNow/82775).
Ukrainian mass drone strike on Moscow region July 20 2026 hit Podolsk fuel depot, Wildberries Koledino hub, and Southern Gates 65,000 sq m park in Domodedovo (Source: @eRadarrua/101780).
Russian Su-34 toward Crimea with Kh-59 threat and Iskander-M threats from Crimea and Taganrog indicate broad ballistic missile alert posture (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69255).
Russian strike on Sumy with seven KAB bombs left three hospitalized and one possibly under rubble with rescue ongoing per OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Nova Poshta terminal near Kharkiv attacked by Russian drones killing four people per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101721).
Zaporizhzhia strike killed one wounded three, damaged five-story building, trapped woman and child under rubble per OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/82774).
Kiev hit by 42 ballistic and ten hypersonic missiles plus drones, largest blow since SMO, warehouses still detonating per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31744).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are intensifying rear-area strikes on Odesa maritime and port infrastructure with cruise missiles, ballistic weapons, and drones, indicating political authorization for such strikes per Two Majors summary. Ukrainian drone campaigns now reach Moscow region logistics including Wildberries and fuel depots, demonstrating deep strike capability. Iskander-M threats from Crimea and Taganrog coupled with Su-34 Kh-59 alerts show elevated missile risk across southern Ukraine. VSU concentration of three brigades at Slaviansk with Russian units 8 km away signals impending ground pressure on the eastern front.
sections.regional_response: Greece blocked the 21st EU sanctions package against Russia over proposed Russian LNG transport ban citing business harm per FT via TASS. Burundi president will attend third Russia-Africa summit per foreign minister. NATO may fail to allocate 140 billion euros to Ukraine over two years per NZZ via ukr_leaks_eng, straining allied resourcing. Kiev Mayor Klitschko criticized Zelensky for dismissing Defense Minister as a mistake per ukr_leaks_eng, indicating internal political friction.
sections.intelligence_notes: Two Majors summary asserts Russian strikes on Odesa and Kiev are belated versus Western drone inflows to Ukraine and calls for air defense expansion and oil refinery protection. TASS reported captured VSU Colombian mercenary claims Kiev knows relatives will not claim payments. Russian MoD claims VSU lost transport and UAV control points on Kramatorsk direction. Black Sea drone activity with Orion UAV and multiple launch points near Tuzly and Vylkove shows sustained maritime ISR and strike coordination.
